FOR PARENTS

HOW ELEVATE FAITH NOW STREAMING WORKS

A STREAMING SITE THAT BUILDS FAITH

Elevate Faith Now Streaming works like the streaming sites your family already knows, with one big difference: after the video, your child digs deeper into the story and practices it.

WATCH

One new video a week

Videos arrive weekly and are grouped by month, so your family can browse December, January and beyond like a streaming library.

DIG DEEPER

Verse, story, action, reflection

Each video carries a Dig Deeper companion: a Bible verse, the story retold in detail, a practical action point, and a reflection your child writes, ending with their own action point.

POINTS

Points for finishing

Watching earns 10 points and the Dig Deeper parts earn 30 more, 40 per weekly video (proposed values). Points buy stickers and pets in Rapid Rewards and the gifts you set in Parent Rewards.

SAFE

Free and family friendly

Everything here is free. There are no prices, no stranger reviews and no open forums. Videos unlock one week at a time, in order.

GIFTS

You set the rewards

In Parent's Corner (tap the lock in the header) you add, edit and delete the gifts in Parent Rewards, each with its own point price. Your child redeems with points, and the gift queues for you to fulfill.

SEE

Read their reflections

Parent's Corner also shows your child's points and the reflections they have written, so you can talk about the story together.

Honest note: this is a demo with one demo child and no sign-in. Points, gifts and progress reset when the page is reloaded, and nothing is saved or synced. The demo Parent's Corner PIN is 0000.
